critic.briefing: Sources in play today and what to keep in mind about each: Utility Dive: Utility-industry trade outlet; frames security through regulation, cost and reliability; sympathetic to utilities. The Hacker News: High volume, sponsored content mixed with news; good for the wide-angle view of what else is happening. Industrial Cyber: ICS/OT-only trade outlet; vendor-advertising supported, relays vendor reports and regulator notices with little pushback. The Register Security: Irreverent UK tech press; sceptical of vendors and governments alike, headline tone can trivialise.

top_stories.title: Electric utilities join industries urging renewal of cybersecurity information-sharing law
top_stories.summary: CISA 2015, as the law is often called, provides liability protections for companies sharing cyber threat indicators amongst themselves and with federal agencies. It is set to expire next month.
